entities.summary: Deborah De Robertis is a performance artist and photographer from Luxembourg. She studied at the School of Graphic Research in Belgium and as of May 2020 was living in Brussels. Deborah De Robertis was a painters & sculptors from Luxembourg (b. 1984-02-12, Luxembourg). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
